items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: He's a hell of a comedian.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's supposed to have been real funny.

Oh, who told me about the Fourth of July pass here? Memphis Lewis. I don't know him. He's a hell of a comedian. He come in just like you and he had a damn skull cap in his pocket. And he put on that skull cap on his head. Mm-hmm. Pull out a red hancher. Mm-hmm. And put it around his neck. Mm-hmm. And jokes. He can crack more jokes than they got on that... And they got dishes in there. And he dances a little. Mm-hmm. He's got a good age on him. And he's the hell of a comedian. Well, I never saw him. Memphis Lewis.…
